item.title: राजनीतिः - नारायणः, Shulman
item.description:
Rāja-nīti 4. 204–285

204.
Never tire of protecting people.
When people in distress cry out to you,
listen to them, remove their suffering.
Don’t give any responsibility to bad people.

205.
The people (rāṣṭramu) seek the welfare of a king
who holds their wellbeing in his heart.
Don’t discount this truth.
If all the people, from the Brahmins down,
want the same thing,
God, who moves inside them,
will surely give it.
